spans.s:
Kūcakra is a word occurring only once in an obscure verse
of the Rigveda,^1 where Zimmer^2 suggests that it has the sense
of the wheel by which water is raised from a well. Much
more probable is the interpretation of Roth,^3 who understands
it to mean the female breast.
1) x. 102, 11.
2) Altindisches Leben, 157. Cf. Geldner,
Vedische Studien, 2, 14.
3) St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
